notes.title: WarChess Casual competitive game"The Last Bug" Launches on November 8, 2024
notes.notes:
WarChess Casual competitive game "The Last Bug" published by Bitter Pomelo Games, officially launches on November 8, 2024. [b]Price: ¥18, with a 40% OFF discount in the first week[/b]. The game combines unique skills of bug heroes, randomly generated chessboards, and random events that influence the battle, forming its core gameplay. Invite your friends and become the strongest and cutest Bug King in fast-paced, fair matches!

[previewyoutube=CfWEDrezHZI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1991910/_/

[b][h2]Turn-based Grid Combat, Shrinking Zone Capture the Flag[/h2][/b]
Revisit the classic strategy gameplay from your childhood! With turn-based mechanics and diverse terrain elements, the game retains the strategic depth of traditional tactical games while introducing a shrinking zone mechanic to speed up the pace. Experience high-octane moments as heroes clash in a mix of strategy and competition, offering a unique blend of tactical fun and excitement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/a719e3074bc9eb4931d34b467ace1debda1d0468.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/8d200535f1bef9f077b7ba2bb265050d1c0cf106.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Adorable Forest Insects Compete in the Arena[/h2][/b]
Cute insects face off in the arena! Don’t be fooled by their adorable appearances; each one has unique skills: the usually timid [Archer] "Bobo" can snipe opponents from a distance; the martial arts-loving [Balanced Warrior] "Rocky" fights barehanded with moves so powerful that opponents dare not approach; and the middle-aged [Burst Warrior] "Doudi" still has a fiery spirit and loves to fight with his staff. Assemble these talented insects and join the fray!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/69fee16d88b0f008fcd8af1c367e34b04096204e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/f583f73cf612e5dbe7d6d96db09646ed9b7c2310.png[/img]

[b][h2]Randomly Generated Maps, Three Game Modes[/h2][/b]
The game features Roguelike elements with randomly generated tiles like grasslands, snowfields, and water areas, each with different obstacles or hidden elements. Even if the battle is in the enemy's favor, random events like rain can disrupt their strategy, giving you a chance to turn the tide. Bring your sharpest mind and strongest heart for a comeback win! Enjoy different gameplay experiences with modes like 1V1, 2V2, and 4-player free-for-all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/760b8f58c4204d636bf029b995a78ab59795e486.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/62e4e704b92f1eedb9497458271285cc7c22960c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/5b078d1c9c6a5c7b613d305fed0eb899726fb791.png[/img]

[b][h2]Troll Your Friends in Hilarious Multiplayer[/h2][/b]
The forest comedians are here! Trolling your teammates is the right way to enjoy casual matches. Dig pits for your friends, trap each other, and keep the antics going until the last moment of the match. Have fun without fear in casual games, but don’t slack off in ranked matches! Work together to corner your opponents: you scout and I'll throw acorns, leaving them nowhere to hide!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/b4862e31fd72fbf1bedab8a2d00bf6bb19e52c80.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/814ab79fed6ab944d386e8c9449dd17e91bf8fa7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Last Bug Demo Shines at the 2024 Steam China Curators Conference!
notes.notes:
"The Last Bug" is a turn-based casual competitive game published by Bitter Grapefruit Games. The game has participated in the "2024 Steam China Curators Conference" and players can download the demo from September 24th to 30th, 2024, to experience the fun of strategic turn-based battles. Come and choose your cute and quirky insect heroes to compete on the battlefield, use strategies to defeat opponents, use various props to prank your teammates, and become the strongest and cutest insect in fast-paced confrontations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/8b0171fbda6ef791e253ad7bcb584c3ebbdfd741.jpg[/img]

[h2]【Various Cute Insects from the Forest, Competing on the Battlefield】[/h2]
In the distant fantasy forest, a group of animals with diverse personalities and unique abilities gather together, following the ancient "Forest Law", and engage in one after another arena contest of wisdom and courage. The cute insects may look silly, but they each have unique skills: The usually timid "BoBo" can withstand cannon fire and snipe at hidden opponents on the battlefield; "LoqiQi", who has loved martial arts since childhood, fights bare-handed, his moves and power making opponents dare not approach; "DouDi", already middle-aged, still has a spirit of defiance and loves to fight. The forest is filled with such a group of insects, making the competition absolutely thrilling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/f1e1855dce1e878d18d5fc6c6fb561b62203d545.jpg[/img]

[h2]【Turn-based Grid Movement, New Chess, New Fun】[/h2]
The game cleverly combines the strategic depth of turn-based chess with the tension and excitement of a shrinking battle royale circle. Players will play various adorable animal characters, using terrain advantages, strategic layouts, and randomly generated props and events to engage in a battle of wits and courage with opponents. Whether you're pursuing individual glory in solo mode, testing team coordination in duo mode, or engaging in chaotic and exciting 4-player free-for-alls, you can immerse yourself in the fun of strategy and competition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/086db25b200c66b3811960331ade00e27e68e24b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4559752eda8c7b44d08d25475b267ae7d95fe1d7.png[/img]

[h2]【Randomly Constructed Scenes, Hundreds of Strategies】[/h2]
The game's battleground chessboard is randomly generated, making each game a unique experience. Terrain such as grasslands, snowfields, and waters not only affect character movement and combat effects but also hide various randomly generated obstacles and treasures. At the same time, changes in weather like rainfall and sandstorms can disrupt the game at any time, forcing players to seek breakthroughs in the unknown. It's time for a comeback against the wind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/bb64a625400340d0bdda1a095b7671af9b81d4fe.png[/img]

[h2]【Prank Your Friends, Double the Fun】[/h2]
Players can meet like-minded friends in the game, form teams, and share game insights and tactical skills. At the same time, the game will regularly host various events and competitions, providing players with a stage to showcase their abilities, with the chance to win generous rewards. Of course, perhaps "pranking your teammates" is the right way to enjoy the game. I dig a hole for you, you trap me, and we torment each other until the last moment of the match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4959cca9bd1f934c9df2203f7ac73645d0f066a0.png[/img]

"The Last Bug" is about to be officially released, and the new chapter of turn-based strategy confrontation has already begun. Head to the Steam store and Steam platform now, follow us, add to your wishlist, and book your seat at this feast of wisdom and courage! Players can also join our official QQ group chat [285140744] for more close interaction. We look forward to chatting with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/171f7194f28dbfec0cb8147ababe2ddf3a3acac1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Last Bug Demo Launches on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]WarChess + MOBA + Shrinking Circle Mechanic = Casual Strategy Competition[/b][/h3]

Relive the classic fun of childhood chess games! With turn-based gameplay and various terrain elements, the game maintains the strategic essence of WarChess while adding a shrinking circle mechanic to speed up the game pace, resulting in more high-energy moments. Different hero roles like Warriors, Archers, and Supports each have unique abilities, making them formidable on their own. With the right strategy, you can execute quick attacks or comebacks! Alternatively, you can play it safe and wait for the perfect moment to claim victory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/bdad0b57f63fb00ab670b41886d1c3c642169fd9.png[/img]

[h3][b]Randomly Generated Battlefields Every Match[/b][/h3]

Strategize with ever-changing scenarios! The game is packed with Roguelike elements. Random tiles like grasslands, snowfields, and water areas, along with various obstacles or hidden elements, keep the game fresh. There are even a few treasure chests waiting to be discovered! Even if the enemy has the upper hand, random events like rain can disrupt the battle flow, potentially giving you the edge. Bring your sharpest mind and strongest heart to turn the tide!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/81a1dbdbe582a27fd15e0400f99fb307c2422f48.png[/img]

[h3][b]Multiple Strategic Game Modes[/b][/h3]

Currently, the game offers 1v1 duels, 4-player free-for-alls, and 2v2 team battles. Solo duels emphasize competitiveness, team battles focus on cooperation, and free-for-alls test your judgment of the environment and opponents, offering a deep strategic experience. More modes like Snakes and Ladders and boss fights will be added later, allowing players to explore more fun around the core "WarChess competition" gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4461b8ddc87d450fd00485ac305a80a0bdab8f77.png[/img]

Finally, we thank all the players for their support and anticipation, as well as for the feedback and understanding during the beta testing phase. *The Last Bug* will be officially released this year. The new experience of "turn-based strategy competition" begins with this demo. Head over to the Steam store page now, follow the game, and add it to your wishlist. Don’t miss out!

notes.title: 战棋休闲竞技游戏《动物：森林法则》，一起虫林乱斗！
notes.notes:
《动物：森林法则》是一款由苦柚Games发行的战棋休闲竞技游戏。挑选不同性格又可爱呆萌的虫虫英雄角逐赛场！综合英雄独特的技能、赛场随机构建的棋盘、影响战局的随机事件，用策略击败对手。还能用各式道具挖坑弹飞，整蛊队友~在快节奏的公平对抗中，成为最强、最萌的虫虫！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/6f944be35d79e120e0779ac5d4bfd871c7d30a0a.png[/img]

【森林百变萌虫，角逐竞技赛场】
可爱虫虫申请出战！别看他们呆萌的外表，但各个身怀绝“技”：平时胆小的“波波”一到赛场就能扛炮狙击暗处的对手；从小热爱武术的“洛奇奇”赤手空拳，其招式和威力让对手都不敢靠近；“斗帝”已到中年，仍旧有一股子不服气、爱耍棍打斗的劲儿。森林里集结这样一群虫虫，比赛一定精彩绝伦！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/29e6bea034e46dad03de155f28ceaf1cc8715425.png[/img]

【回合制走格子，新战棋新趣味】
回温童年的经典棋趣玩法！回合制、不同地形要素，保留战棋的策略性之外，游戏还将加入缩圈机制，加快战棋节奏，上演更多高能片段。包含策略与竞技的新战棋，战斗一触即发，让你体验烧脑与戏剧的爽快乐趣。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4461b8ddc87d450fd00485ac305a80a0bdab8f77.png[/img]

【场景随机构建，百种策略乱斗】
随机构建，策略百变！游戏充满各种Roguelike元素。随机地块：草地、雪地、水域等，地块之上将随机生成不同障碍元素或隐藏元素，还有少数的道具宝箱等待挖掘！即使战局优势在敌方，降雨天气等随机事件也将打乱作战节奏，或许能祝你一臂之力。带上最强大脑和最强心脏，逆风翻盘！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/bb64a625400340d0bdda1a095b7671af9b81d4fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4559752eda8c7b44d08d25475b267ae7d95fe1d7.png[/img]

【伙伴挖坑整蛊，开黑快乐加倍】
森林喜剧人集结！“坑队友”才是娱乐赛的正确打开方式。我为你挖坑，你将我困住，我们就这样互相折磨到比赛最后一刻~轻松娱乐无所畏惧，但排位绝不拉胯！合力围堵、你侦测方位，我投送松果，让对手无处遁形！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/4959cca9bd1f934c9df2203f7ac73645d0f066a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/81a1dbdbe582a27fd15e0400f99fb307c2422f48.png[/img]

各位玩家朋友们可以加入我们的官方QQ群聊【285140744】，我们期待与各位更多的密切交流~

notes.title: 《动物：森林法则》线下试玩会圆满结束
notes.notes:
3月30日，《动物：森林法则》发行团队苦柚Games携最新试玩版本参加了第十期机迷营地广州试玩会。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/2977cd4bd477c81649e24094e70fa7536deb8602.jpg[/img]

机迷营地试玩会是由游戏机迷主办，现场提供了大量新游戏及热门游戏的试玩，其中有不少玩家被《动物：森林法则》可爱的画风和“丑萌”的小虫子所吸引。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/3220a50504b53f2a0f15271c59e9f0401bd9da79.jpg[/img]

战棋休闲竞技的玩法也引起了大家的兴趣，团队成员与大家讲述了创意玩法设计的初衷，并在现场临时组织了团队匹配，通过边玩边说的方式，带大家简单体验了新手流程，领略森林竞技场的魅力。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/3d786ad0b37bda1f7d6cb894e5b75ccc2f3396a6.jpg[/img]

《动物：森林法则》团队非常感谢现场朋友们的试玩。今年我们还将参与更多线下展会，提供更多的试玩，希望能多与线下朋友们多多交流，让我们期待下一次更好地相遇！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42645827/ac8e0f162bcfdf6d7571419d181747e0a5e9d137.jpg[/img]
